aarti.tek: Victory to you, Mother Ahoī; victory to you, Mother Ahoī.
Night and day Śiva, Viṣṇu and Brahmā the Creator meditate on you.
aarti.pad1: You are Brahmāṇī, Rudrāṇī and Kamalā; you alone are the mother of the world.
The Sun and the Moon meditate on you, and the sage Nārada sings of you.
aarti.pad2: Mother, your form is stainless, and you give happiness and wealth;
whoever meditates on you gains blessings always.
aarti.pad3: You alone dwell in the netherworld, and you alone give happiness;
you bring to light the fruit of deeds and save from the ocean of the world.
aarti.pad4: In the home where you dwell, virtues arrive;
what a person could not do, he does, and his mind is not afraid.
aarti.pad5: Without you there is no happiness, and no one gains a son;
the plenty of food and drink does not come without you.
aarti.pad6: You are endowed with auspicious virtues and beauty, born of the ocean of milk;
of the fourteen jewels, none attains to you.
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings the āratī of Śrī Ahoī Mother,
great joy wells up in his heart, and his sins fall away.
